## Checklist

- [ ] `python tools/validate_content.py` is clean
- [ ] `python tools/build_exercises.py` was run and its output is committed
- [ ] `python tools/check_solutions.py` and `python -m pytest tools/tests` pass
- [ ] `cd web && npm test` passes (only needed if lessons or the runner changed)
- [ ] I read the lesson in the browser (`npm run dev`) and it makes sense to a complete beginner
- [ ] Every new `assert` in a lesson test has a message that tells the learner what to do
- [ ] A new lesson has one or two review questions in `content/review/questions.json`
- [ ] Site changes: keyboard use, 360 px width and light/dark contrast still work
